was: What the checks hold, and when they run
proposed: What the checks enforce, and when they run
why: «hold» — калька «держат»; проверки по-английски «enforce».

was: Every check is deterministic but the review of the code.
proposed: Every check except the review of the code is deterministic.
why: «but» после сказуемого сначала читается как «но», и фраза спотыкается.

was: those rules of the guidelines the table of checks lists
proposed: the rules of the guidelines that the table of checks lists
why: Два именных оборота подряд без «that» читаются с запинкой.

was: they also run after each of its edits
proposed: the checks also run after each of its edits
why: «they» ближе к «the tests or the code», чем к проверкам.

was: run at a push if the specification
proposed: run on a push if the specification
why: О событиях git говорят «on push», а «at a push» звучит неестественно.

was: The tests run at a push rather than at a commit
proposed: The tests run on a push rather than on a commit
why: О событиях git говорят «on push» и «on commit».

was: No test runs at a push while
proposed: No test runs on a push while
why: О событиях git говорят «on push».

was: so refusing costs nobody a judgement
proposed: so a refusal requires nobody's judgement
why: «costs nobody a judgement» — калька «ни от кого не требует суждения», звучит как «никому не стоит суждения».

was: is bypassed at the first chance
proposed: is bypassed at the first opportunity
why: Устойчивое выражение — «at the first opportunity».

was: can be seen only at the edits, since a commit holds the test and the code together
proposed: can be seen only edit by edit, since a commit contains the test and the code together
why: «at the edits» и «holds» — кальки «при правках» и «содержит».

was: What the sections share is agreed in contracts
proposed: What the sections share is agreed in the contracts section
why: Строчное "contracts" без артикля читается как «в договорах» (нарицательное множественное), а не как имя раздела.

was: Contracts agrees what the sections of the specification share:
proposed: The contracts section agrees on what the sections of the specification share:
why: Строчное "contracts" читается как множественное число, и "Contracts agrees" выглядит ошибкой согласования; к тому же "agree" здесь требует "on".

was: What only one section needs, that section holds itself, except a term
proposed: What only one section needs stays in that section, except a term
why: "that section holds itself" буквально значит «раздел держит самого себя» — русский вынос дополнения вперёд.

was: Contracts exists where the rules of the specification share something
proposed: The contracts section exists where the rules of the specification share something
why: "Contracts exists" выглядит ошибкой согласования: строчное "contracts" читается как множественное число.

was: It stands as a section of its own within the base specification.
proposed: It is a section of its own within the base specification.
why: "stands as a section" — калька «стоит/является»; достаточно "is".

was: A specification with no term and nothing else shared needs none.
proposed: A specification with no term and nothing else shared does not need it.
why: "needs none" после "no term and nothing else" непонятно к чему относится — к терминам или к контрактам.

was: or their own rules for one matter
proposed: or make their own rules for the same matter
why: Правила не "coin" (так говорят о словах), а «для одного и того же» — "for the same matter", не "for one matter".

was: Holding in contracts only what binds more than one section keeps contracts from answering for
proposed: Keeping in the contracts section only what binds more than one section keeps that section from answering for
why: Строчное "contracts" читается как «договоры», а "Holding in" — калька «держать в»; естественно "Keeping in".

was: Contracts exists only to agree what the parts
proposed: The contracts section exists only to agree on what the parts
why: "Contracts exists" выглядит ошибкой согласования, а "agree" здесь требует "on".

was: in the ordinary case of its language
proposed: with the ordinary capitalisation of its language
why: case без letter читается как грамматический падеж, а о регистре букв пишут capitalisation.

was: capitals may stand on one word or on two running (REST API).
proposed: one word, or two in a row (REST API), may be set in capitals.
why: «Заглавными могут стоять» передано дословно: capitals stand on a word не говорят, а two running без words непонятно.

was: three words or more running
proposed: three or more words in a row
why: «Подряд» по-английски — in a row, а running после words знакомо только по three days running.

was: is said in the words
proposed: is made to stand out by the wording
why: «Говорится словами» передано дословно, а said in the words по-английски бессмысленно.

was: binds alike
proposed: binds equally
why: alike как наречие при binds неестественно, нужно equally.

was: A word or two in capitals are most often
proposed: One or two words in capitals are most often
why: A word or two согласуется с единственным числом, и are рядом звучит как ошибка.

was: which no check tells from a word stressed
proposed: which no check can tell apart from an emphasised word
why: Постпозиция a word stressed — калька, а stressed — об ударении, тогда как о выделении — emphasised.

was: Three words running are seldom anything but stress.
proposed: Three words in a row are seldom anything but emphasis.
why: stress — ударение или напряжение, а выделение в тексте — emphasis.

was: A run of abbreviations as long
proposed: A run of abbreviations that long
why: as long без второй части сравнения — калька «такой длины», нужно that long.

was: the status indicates the combined state of the whole group of rules inside it
proposed: the status sums up the state of all the rules inside it
why: «indicates the combined state of the whole group» — нагромождение существительных, калька «является индикатором совокупного состояния».

was: the whole group has that status
proposed: the section is a draft too
why: Статус принадлежит разделу, а не «группе», и «has that status» — калька.

was: , the code and the tests secondary in it.
proposed: , with the code and the tests secondary.
why: Оборот без глагола и с лишним «in it» читается как ошибка.

was: implementing it would fix its incompleteness in the code, or the code would be built on guesses
proposed: implementing it would either lock its gaps into the code or build the code on guesses
why: «fix» — ложный друг «закрепить»: по-английски это «исправить», и фраза читается наоборот.

was: also holds code and tests written earlier, which must be brought to the form the method describes
proposed: also has code and tests written earlier, which must be brought into the form the method describes
why: «holds code» — калька «содержит»; проект код «has», а к форме приводят «into».

was: Only what a commit leaves alone is relieved
proposed: Only what a commit leaves alone may keep its earlier form
why: «is relieved» значит «испытывает облегчение»; это калька «послабление касается».

was: A status of their own for sections and nodes lets
proposed: Giving sections and nodes a status of their own lets
why: Подлежащее «A status of their own for sections and nodes» — калька, носитель построит фразу от действия.

was: without withdrawing its status
proposed: without withdrawing its approval
why: Статус не «withdraw»; отзывают одобрение, как и говорит сам метод.

was: Every link names what it means by a type.
proposed: Every link names what it means through its type.
why: "what it means by a type" читается как «что связь понимает под словом type».

was: the linking node holds a condition the linked rule depends on
proposed: the linking node states a condition the linked rule depends on
why: "holds" рядом с "condition" читается как «условие выполняется»; «содержит условие» — "states a condition".

was: the linking node, of an extension, changes the linked main rule
proposed: the linking node, which belongs to an extension, changes the linked main rule
why: Обособленное "of an extension" — калька «узел расширения», по-английски так не вставляют.

was: So it holds no link of another type to it.
proposed: So the linking node has no link of another type to the linked one.
why: Два "it" подряд — непонятно, у кого нет связи и к кому.

was: as an operator starting an export
proposed: such as an operator starting an export
why: "as" вместо "such as" перед примером — калька «как».

was: No check can grade it.
proposed: No check can assess it.
why: "grade" — «ставить оценку» (школьную); «оценить» здесь — "assess".

was: is the same guess one step later
proposed: is the same guess, one step further on
why: «на шаг дальше» — не о времени; "one step later" звучит как «шагом позже».

was: It does so in enough detail to be read only one way
proposed: It does so in enough detail to be read in only one way
why: Без предлога "in" оборот разговорный и спотыкается при чтении.

was: It never restates what they state.
proposed: It never restates what those nodes state.
why: Сразу после перечня "exact values, examples and the edge cases" местоимение "they" цепляется за него, а не за узлы базы.

was: which stands in the section of the stack;
proposed: which goes in the section on the stack;
why: "stands in the section of the stack" — двойная калька «стоит в разделе стека»; естественно "goes in the section on the stack".

was: would leave the base binding nowhere
proposed: would leave the base without force anywhere
why: "leave the base binding nowhere" — калька «лишила бы силы везде», читается с запинкой.

was: Read beside the nodes it implements, an appendix node restating them
proposed: Read alongside the nodes it implements, an appendix node restating them
why: Документы читают "alongside" друг друга, а "beside" — чисто пространственное «рядом».

was: a copy drifts from what it copies
proposed: a copy drifts away from what it copies
why: "drift from" без "away" звучит обрубленно; носитель скажет "drifts away from".

was: is found when that rule changes and is read beside it.
proposed: is found when that rule changes, and is read alongside it.
why: Без запятой "and is read beside it" прочитывается как продолжение "that rule changes", а "beside" — пространственное «рядом».

was: the code implementing the specification outside its guidelines
proposed: the code implementing the parts of the specification outside its guidelines
why: outside its guidelines цепляется и к code, и к specification, а с the parts ясно, что исключены guidelines, а не место кода.

was: are not the system's code. A project's
proposed: are not part of the system's code. A project's
why: «Не являются кодом системы» по-английски — are not part of the system's code, иначе звучит как неудачное тождество.

was: Whether a file is the system's code
proposed: Whether a file is part of the system's code
why: Файл не «есть код системы», а входит в него: is part of.

was: what serves the work on the system
proposed: whatever supports the work on the system
why: «То, что обслуживает работу над системой» передано дословно: serves the work носитель не скажет, естественно supports the work.

was: considered implemented only by its code and a passing test together
proposed: considered implemented only when its code and a passing test are both present
why: considered implemented by its code читается как «код считает правило реализованным», потому что агент при considered — тот, кто считает.

was: so the tests are on the side of the code
proposed: so the tests fall on the code's side of that line
why: «На стороне кода» передано дословно, а сторону границы по-английски называют fall on X's side of the line.

was: Where a file lives is the same to every check, so it draws that line.
proposed: A file's location is the same for every check, so the location draws that line.
why: «Одинаково для каждой проверки» — the same for, не to, а it неясно: файл это или его место.

was: The one source of truth is the specification
proposed: The single source of truth is the specification
why: Устойчивое выражение — «single source of truth», а «the one source» звучит как «тот самый источник».

was: The one source of truth about the system
proposed: The single source of truth about the system
why: Устойчивое выражение — «single source of truth».

was: The code implements it and holds nothing of its own.
proposed: The code implements it and contains nothing of its own.
why: «holds» — калька «держит»; о содержимом кода говорят «contains».

was: It is repaired when the rule is revised.
proposed: The defect is fixed when the rule is revised.
why: Дефект по-английски «fix», а не «repair», и «It» можно отнести и к правилу, и к дефекту.

was: which of them holds
proposed: which of them is right
why: «holds» для «верен» неясно: читается как «какой из них держится».

was: the disagreement is found by a machine
proposed: any disagreement is found by a machine
why: Определённый артикль указывает на конкретное расхождение, которого в тексте нет; нужно «any».

was: A node holds what is applied together, and nothing applied apart
proposed: A node contains what is applied together, and nothing applied separately
why: apart для «порознь» звучит странно, нужно separately, а holds двусмысленно рядом с hold в смысле «быть верным».

was: Requirements that a reader needs together, to carry out any one of them rightly, stand in one node.
proposed: Requirements that a reader needs together to carry out any one of them correctly belong in one node.
why: rightly значит «справедливо, по праву», а не «правильно», и stand in one node — калька «стоят в одном узле» вместо belong in.

was: A requirement carried out rightly without the other requirements of its node stands in a node of its own.
proposed: A requirement that can be carried out correctly without the other requirements of its node belongs in a node of its own.
why: carried out rightly читается как «уже выполненное по праву», тогда как «правильно выполняется» — can be carried out correctly.

was: A requirement it needs that stands in another node
proposed: A requirement it needs that is stated in another node
why: stands in для «стоит в» — калька, а требование is stated in a node.

was: is carried out where they narrow it.
proposed: is carried out even where they narrow it.
why: Пропущено «и там» (even), и без него фраза говорит, что мысль выполняют только там, где уточнения её сужают.

was: a node that holds requirements carried out apart does not say which of them the code carries out.
proposed: a node that contains requirements carried out separately does not say which of them the code implements.
why: apart для «порознь» — separately, а код правило implements, не carries out.

was: Naming rules
proposed: Rules for naming
why: В спецификации о правилах Naming rules читается как «как называть правила».

was: a field used apart from its object
proposed: a field used without its object
why: apart from по-английски чаще значит «кроме», и фраза читается как «поле, используемое помимо своего объекта».

was: Written so, the key may be a general word.
proposed: Written this way, the key may be a general word.
why: written so звучит архаично, естественно written this way.

was: A general one there means
proposed: There, a general name means
why: a general one there — тяжёлое замещение с повисшим there, а носитель вынесет There вперёд и назовёт name.

was: a sort of request in one log, a user's action in another and a sort of error in a third
proposed: the kind of request in one log, the user's action in another and the kind of error in a third
why: a sort of request разговорно значит «нечто вроде запроса», а «вид запроса» — the kind of request.

was: Code font tells it from an ordinary word.
proposed: Code font sets it apart from an ordinary word.
why: tell X from Y требует подлежащего-человека («отличить»), а шрифт не tells, а sets apart.
